prompt: A JTabbedPane holds Inbox, Drafts and Sent tabs. Complete refreshCurrent so a label reads "Viewing: Drafts", and selectTab so it selects a tab by title and ignores titles that do not exist.
explanation: A JTabbedPane keeps its titles separately from the components inside each tab, so getTitleAt(getSelectedIndex()) is how you name the visible tab. indexOfTab returns -1 for a title the pane does not have, which is the guard that stops selectTab from throwing on a bad name. Because setSelectedIndex fires the pane's ChangeListener, the label updates itself whether the change came from your code or from a click.
hints: tabs.getSelectedIndex() gives you a number; tabs.getTitleAt(index) turns it into the title.
tabs.indexOfTab(title) searches by title and returns -1 when there is no match.
Check for -1 before calling setSelectedIndex, otherwise an unknown title clears the selection.
